home.title: Welcome Adventurer
home.description: Welcome to the core database. Select any article from the index list on the left to navigate directly to world locations, game systems, character classes, or magic schools.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Frontline fighter who protects allies and overwhelms enemies with powerful weapon techniques.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Disciplined defender clad in heavy plate, trained to absorb massive damage.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Holy warrior combining martial combat with sacred light magic.

dark-knight.name: Dark Knight
dark-knight.description: Knight who sacrifices vitality to channel dark magic and inflict heavy damage.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.description: Fierce berserker who enters chaotic rages to increase strength and speed.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Martial artist using internal energy and rapid hand-to-hand combat.

blademaster.name: Blademaster
blademaster.description: Master of swordcraft delivering high-burst damage through rapid strikes.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Long-range hunter skilled in wilderness survival and animal companions.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Fast assassin using stealth, traps, poisons, and precise attacks.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Quick-witted rogue excelling at stealing loot and dodging attacks.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Shadow master who eliminates high-value targets instantly.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.description: Tamer of wild beasts who commands animals in battle.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Elemental spellcaster unleashing destructive fire, ice, and lightning.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Holy caster who heals allies and protects them with sacred shields.

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Nature guardian commanding plants, animals, storms, and shapeshifting.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.description: Spiritual guide calling upon elemental totems and ancestral spirits.

enchanter.name: Enchanter
enchanter.description: Tactical spellcaster specializing in crowd control and illusions.

bard.name: Bard
bard.description: Musical performer inspiring allies and weakening enemies.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Forbidden caster commanding undead minions and curses.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description: Caster forming pacts with avatars and elemental spirits.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Experimenter creating explosives, elixirs, and chemical mixtures.

arcane.name: Arcane Magic
arcane.description: General magic manipulating raw aetheric forces for utility, barrier creation, rapid repositioning, and targeted force missiles.

aether-light.name: Aether Light
aether-light.description: Illuminates dark dungeons and reveals invisible traps within a 15 meter radius.

force-push.name: Force Push
force-push.description: Emits a wave of kinetic force knocking enemies backward and interrupting spell casts.

magic-missile.name: Magic Missile
magic-missile.description: Fires 3 homing force projectiles that bypass physical defense and track targets.

mana-spark.name: Mana Spark
mana-spark.description: Instantly restores 10 Mana points to an ally or the caster.

arcane-shield.name: Arcane Shield
arcane-shield.description: Creates a protective barrier absorbing oncoming damage via Mana points instead of Health.

blink-step.name: Blink Step
blink-step.description: Short distance teleportation leaving behind an decoy illusion that draws threat.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Instantly blinks the caster up to 20 meters forward in their camera direction.

fire.name: Fire Magic
fire.description: Volatile pyromantic incantations that deliver explosive area-of-effect damage and leave targets burning over time.
fire.modifiers: +20% Critical Spell Damage, +15% Fire Resistance, -10% Cast Speed

cinder.name: Cinder
cinder.description: Sparks a minor flame on the target, dealing minor damage over 6 seconds.

flame-burst.name: Flame Burst
flame-burst.description: Releases a sudden ring of heat around the caster, knocking back nearby attackers.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.description: Sets enemy armor alight, reducing fire resistance by 15%.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurls an explosive sphere of fire that detonates on impact dealing heavy AoE damage.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.description: Instantly ignites all active burn effects on surrounding targets for burst damage.

ironpeak.name: Ironpeak Mountains
ironpeak.description: A towering mountain range filled with sky temples, ancient mines, and clans of battle-hardened guardians.

sunscorch.name: Sunscorch Desert
sunscorch.description: A vast golden desert hiding buried cities, colossal sandworms, and merchant kingdoms.

frostveil.name: Frostveil Tundra
frostveil.description: A frozen wasteland where ancient ice dragons sleep beneath glaciers and wandering spirits guide travelers.

whispering-mire.name: Whispering Mire
whispering-mire.description: A poisonous swamp filled with ancient trees, hidden villages, witch covens, and creatures that mimic lost travelers.

azure-expanse.name: Azure Expanse
azure-expanse.description: A massive ocean region containing pirate kingdoms, underwater temples, sea monsters, and eclipse islands.

emberfall.name: Emberfall Caldera
emberfall.description: A volcanic wasteland ruled by fire giants and molten war machines.

cloudspire.name: Cloudspire Isles
cloudspire.description: Floating islands connected by magical bridges and guarded by storm spirits and sky pirates.

umbral-hollow.name: Umbral Hollow
umbral-hollow.description: A realm trapped in permanent darkness where shadows take physical form.

star-elves.name: Star Elves
star-elves.description: Elegant descendants of celestial beings who draw power from starlight and possess a deep connection to ancient magic.

dwarves.name: Stoneforged Dwarves
dwarves.description: Proud underground builders and master engineers known for their legendary armor, resilient bodies, and powerful clan traditions.

storm-orcs.name: Storm Orcs
storm-orcs.description: Nomadic warriors who live beneath thunderous skies and channel the fury of storms through ritual combat.

drakari.name: Drakari
drakari.description: Dragon-blooded people who inherit elemental breath, powerful scales, and memories passed down from their ancient ancestors.

feykin.name: Feykin
feykin.description: Playful and unpredictable beings from enchanted forests who use illusion, charm, and nature magic to confuse their enemies.

goblins.name: Glimmer Goblins
goblins.description: Clever scavengers and inventive tinkerers who turn discarded objects into dangerous tools, traps, and unpredictable weapons.

hollowborn.name: Hollowborn
hollowborn.description: Undead souls who have regained their free will and now seek a purpose in a world that fears and hunts them.

humans.name: Aetherian Humans
humans.description: Adaptable explorers who have settled nearly every region of Aetheria and learned to combine many different forms of magic.

customization.name: Character Customization
customization.description: Create a character with unique appearance, equipment, and identity.

leveling.name: Leveling
leveling.description: Progress through combat, quests, exploration, and achievements.

dual-classing.name: Dual Classing
dual-classing.description: Combine two job paths to create unique synergies.

mounts.name: Mounts
mounts.description: Travel across Aetheria with land and flying mounts.

pvp.name: PvP
pvp.description: Test your skills against other players.

housing.name: Player Housing
housing.description: Claim and customize your own home.

crafting.name: Crafting
crafting.description: Gather resources and create valuable items.

exploration.name: Exploration
exploration.description: Discover hidden locations, ruins, treasures, and mysteries.
